Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original

delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS The bidder must submit self attested copies of organization registration documents such as PAN card firm or company registration certificate and valid address 6 / 9 proof. The bidder must submit a CA certified Annual Turnover Certificate for the financial years 2023 to 2024 202 4 to 2025 and 2025 to 2026. The bidder must submit copies of Income Tax Returns ITR for the last 3 financial years. The bidder must submit a point by point OEM Compliance Sheet of the BoQ specifications along with suppo rting datasheets and documents. Documentary proof of the Average Annual Financial Turnover of the OEM must be uploaded along with the bid. A valid Bank Solvency Certificate of at least Rs 30 Lakh must be submitted. The bidder must possess and upload a valid CMMI Level 3 Certificate. Assembled PCs are strictly not allowed. Only reputed brands featured in the Top IDC report shall be quoted by the bidder. All desktop systems must be supplied with pre installed original Windows 11 Professional operating syste m. A genuine license of Microsoft Office Professional 2024 latest version must be in stalled in all desktops alo ng with an antivirus client updated with the latest virus definitions. The participating bidder must have a minimum 4 Star rating on the GeM portal. The quoted Desktop computer must meet all required technical features and must be supported by a Bid S pecific Manufacturer Authorization Form MAF from t he OEM. The OEM or authorized reseller must hold valid ISO 9001 2015 ISO 45001 2018 ISO 27001 2022 ISO 14001 2015 BIS IDC certificate RoHS Energy Star rating and CE certificate for All in One and Desktop systems. The OEM of the quoted antivirus software must be certified with ISO 20000 1 20 18 ISO IEC 27001 2022 an d ISO 9001 2015. The bidder must upload a complete list of authorized service centres along with their addresses and conta ct details. The bidder must submit a duly signed Non Fraud Self Declaration Certificate. The bidder or its OEM themselves or through resellers must certify that the equipment and system softwar e provided are not End of Life products and that complete maintenance support updates and security patc hes for the proposed products will be provided till the end of the warranty period .
